title: DraftKings Offers $200 Sports Betting Bonus
subtitle: New Users Get Bonus by Betting $5 on First Game
excerpt: DraftKings launches a $200 bonus bet promotion for new users who wager $5 on college football games.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
DraftKings has launched a promotion that offers new users a $200 bonus in bets when they wager just $5 on their first college football game. The bonus is awarded in eight $25 installments, delivered in two groups of two bets every seven days, over a 21-day period. The bonus has no cash value but can be used to bet on NFL games, MLB, and other sports available on the platform.

How the $200 Bonus Works

To qualify, users must create a new DraftKings account and place their first $5 bet on a game with minimum odds of -500 or greater. Once the bet is processed, the platform will credit the bonus in the form of eight $25 bets, which will be available for seven days after receipt. Winnings obtained from bonus bets do not include the wager itself, only the cash prizes.

Featured Games Driving the Promotion

The main focus of the campaign is the matchup between Houston and Texas Tech, taking place on Wednesday. The game is highlighted due to an analysis of Houston's offensive performance, which leads in points and yards per game, while Texas Tech maintains a good conversion record in the red zone.

Related DraftKings Pick 6 Promotions

In addition to the betting offer, DraftKings also offers the DraftKings Pick 6 Promo, which grants $50 in contest entries when you spend $5. Pick 6 is a fantasy sports game where users predict whether athletes will exceed or fall short of statistical projections. Bonus entries are valid only for Pick 6 contests and cannot be withdrawn.

Responsible Gaming Tools

To ensure conscious use, DraftKings provides a Responsible Gaming Center, with deposit, wagering, and time limit tools, as well as 24/7 chat support and access to helplines for gambling problems.

With information from CBS Sports, RotoWire, WTOP News.
